review: She needs to be at 50% HP or below to show her true potential. Shi Ishmael is a really good and well rounded high-risk, high-reward ID that can utilize her own poise. She doesn't necessarily need Uptie 4 but it helps. Practically unusable for the current Mirror Dungeon 2 due to a Starlight buff that heals everyone at the start of any combat encounter. No notable E.G.O. synergies
